description:
One thing that was read: a document, a table, an application or a transaction stream.

The id is derived from the kind, the source's own key and the digest of its bytes, so a
changed file is a different source and the same bytes always give the same id.

digest.description: The digest of the source's bytes as read
digest.title: Digest

key.description: The source's own identifier, for example 'PS26-4' or 'FIRM-001'
key.title: Key

kind.description: What sort of source it is, for example 'document' or 'table'
kind.title: Kind

locator.description: Where the source was read from: a path in this repository or a URL
locator.title: Locator

terms.description: The terms on which the source may be reused, as recorded
terms.title: Terms

title.description: The source's title as it gives it
title.title: Title

title: Source
